tests.name: Runtime environment
tests.description: Capture only browser-exposed origin, viewport, input, platform, and API signals.
tests.instructions: Review the detected values, then save the observation. Capability is recorded from runtime signals rather than inferred from browser branding.

tests.name: Pointer lifecycle
tests.description: Observe pointer down, movement, release/cancel, type, primary state, pressure, and contact geometry.
tests.instructions: Press or touch inside the contact field, move while held, and release. A complete down/up or down/cancel lifecycle passes the test.

tests.name: Touch Events lifecycle
tests.description: Observe touchstart, touchmove, touchend/cancel, contact identifiers, and simultaneous-contact high-water count.
tests.instructions: Place one or more fingers inside the contact field, move them, and release. If this browser/device does not expose Touch Events, record the expected platform-dependent absence.

profiles.description: Default profile: compare declared expectation with actual API exposure and behavior.
